free_tier.stated: 3,000 outbound emails per month with no daily cap, 1,000 inbound emails per month, 2 custom sending domains, at USD 0 with no card
free_tier.notes: Hourly sending limits apply to every account and on the free plan stay below the paid ones; mail sent beyond the hourly limit is dropped, not queued. The free plan gets no 12% overage buffer. A new account starts in Test Mode, 100 emails in total to at most 7 unique recipients, until a domain is added and an account verification form is approved. SMTP, the REST API, webhooks, inbound routing and 14 days of searchable logs are on the free plan, with 100 test emails a month. The next plan is USD 10 per month for 25,000 emails.

per_object_cap.stated: 24 MB maximum message size over SMTP

retention.stated: 14 days of searchable logs on the free plan

interface_detail: SMTP at smtp.maileroo.com on port 465 with SSL or 587 and 2525 with STARTTLS, and the REST email API; the interface vocabulary has no smtp term
tooling: any SMTP client, or the REST API and the vendor's SDKs; a one-click Cloudflare integration writes the DNS records
chaining: 3,000 a month with no daily cap, so a month can be spent in a burst within the hourly limit; pairs with its own inbound routing at 1,000 a month or with Cloudflare Email Routing for receiving.

limits.value: 3,000 outbound emails per month; past the quota nothing more is sent until the month resets, and the free plan has no overage buffer
an hourly sending limit that grows over time and stays below the paid plans; mail beyond it is dropped. The free-plan figure is unverified: behind a sign-up
Test Mode until a domain is added and an account verification form is approved, typically within 12 business hours: 100 emails in total to at most 7 unique recipients

limits_note: counts of things, not rates, so no vocabulary kind names them: 2 custom sending domains on the free plan, plus a sandbox domain that sends to up to 7 approved test recipients; 1,000 inbound emails per month.

identity_cost.detail: The signup form asks for a name, an email address and a password of at least 8 characters behind a Cloudflare Turnstile check, with no card. Registration and login through a VPN or proxy are refused. Leaving Test Mode needs a domain and an account verification form, reviewed typically within 12 business hours, that declares transactional or marketing use; the verification checks for a valid website associated with the account. Whether a phone number is asked is unverified: behind a sign-up. The compulsory DNS records are SPF (v=spf1 include:_spf.maileroo.com -all) and a DKIM TXT record; DMARC is optional.

reliability_note: mail beyond the hourly limit is dropped rather than queued
